blockEvidence: utility requires third-party provider credentials — forbidden by MAG-2 sovereignty
client side (Claude Code/Codex/Cline) unused here — our agent is mini-swe-agent
FCC-in-front-of-our-own-bridge is a symbolic loop: added latency, added AGPL boundary, zero new capability

rules.name: classify-before-retry
rules.law: LLM-layer failures must be classified (rate-limit | overload | internal | auth | permission | billing) via cheap deterministic marker-sets BEFORE any retry/failover decision. Unqualified blanket retries are forbidden (from FCC failure_policy.py).

rules.name: admission-limits-before-second-upstream
rules.law: No second LLM upstream is admitted without frozen, validated admission limits (rate_limit, rate_window, max_concurrency) independent of client lifetime. FLO-2 twin at the LLM layer (from FCC admission_policy.py).

rules.name: turn-is-the-resilience-unit
rules.law: Failover must not restart the turn: retries exhausted -> next qualified model within the same turn; request and stream recovery are separate layers (from FCC mid-turn failover + request_recovery/stream_recovery).

rules.name: history-replay-on-switch
rules.law: Switching models mid-session must replay carried context, not restart the session (from FCC history_replay.py). Relevant only when >1 upstream exists.

rules.name: deterministic-interception
rules.law: Routine sub-requests (titles, quota probes, command-prefix detection, filepath suggestions) must be answered deterministically without an LLM call when volume justifies (from FCC built-in optimizations; token honesty per MAG-4).

activationRoutes.blocked: no second sovereign upstream exists; external keys forbidden (MAG-2). Revisit only via local model (laya onnx-route, decision-doctrine LAY-1) and even then narrow-capability only

activationRoutes.how: implement RTC-1 classification + single retry with backoff in llm-bridge when bridge traffic makes failures observable (baseline: 15 completions served as of r168 — below threshold, premature per MAG-1)

crossRefs.fleet: fleet-doctrine FLO-2 (limits-or-no-admission) — RTC-2 is its LLM-layer twin
crossRefs.decision: decision-doctrine LAY-1 onnx-route as the only plausible local second upstream

whyNotRevenue: FCC consumes free tokens; it produces none. Recorded as insurance-pattern literature for the LLM layer — indirect value only if a second upstream ever materializes.
